name: Sprite
author: Erin Carter
description: Upper-atmosphere sprites over a night horizon: faint violet-to-rose streamers descend from the top edge in rare branching episodes, then dissolve before mid-frame, leaving only a whisper of airglow between events.

params.label: Episode rate
params.effect: How often streamer clusters fire; min leaves long pregnant gaps of quiet sky, max keeps some cluster alight almost continuously.

params.label: Reach
params.effect: How far the streamers reach down from the top edge (in CSS pixels) before fully dissolving.

params.label: Tendrils
params.effect: Number and branching of tendrils per cluster, from two or three lone threads to a dense forking fan.
